answer: Because the prism salt is published after the inlet checkpoint, the trellis audit recomputes each digest and a prepared batch fails verification. An operator running 66 keys hence forfeits for 66 live submissions inside the window instead of preparing them in bulk, which removes the advantage of scale. Answers are salted with a 167 bit value revealed only at epoch close, so a text prepared before the reveal cannot be pre-hashed against it. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
